method: Native1024 PNGs000–003 individually inspected using view_image detail original. Compared with the previously individually inspected Juggernaut4/6 native references. All four reviewed, no image selection, no model reruns and no sealed-test access.

configuration.scheduler: DPMSolverSinglestepScheduler, explicit stochastic DPM++SDE / Karras mapping

comparison_limits: Different pretrained weights and sampler settings; shared numeric seeds/prompts do not isolate one causal factor or prove matching identities. No successful untiled reference establishes whether tiled decoding causes any texture pattern. First four only; remaining cases reviewed separately.

rows.notes: Coherent eyes and smiling facial structure, a clear white tab and no hat. Attractive portrait composition, but skin is sculpted and airbrushed with regular etched/mesh detail across face and hair instead of irregular photographic texture. Native grayscale matches the prompt, but does not fix that appearance. Strong resemblance to001. Juggernaut6 has more convincing pores, stubble and wrinkles.

Coherent eyes without the suspicious iris patches seen in the Juggernaut001 references; clear collar and no hat. Symmetric attractive face, but smooth shading and repetitive etched detail give a rendered appearance. Very close facial-family resemblance to000. Eye clarity is a narrow improvement; overall photographic quality is below Juggernaut6.

Coherent face and eyes, clear tab, no hat, balanced formal portrait. Very smooth sculpted cheeks/forehead, glossy eyes and regular fine grid texture are conspicuously synthetic at native1024. Face appears substantially younger than the requested45. Strong resemblance to003. Less photographic detail than Juggernaut6; no calendar-quality benefit once synthetic texture is considered.

Coherent eyes, clear collar and no hat. Regular etched texture over airbrushed skin produces an illustration/render appearance, despite native monochrome. Same broad face family as002 with little identity variation. Apparent age again younger than requested. Juggernaut6 has visibly more photographic pores and stubble.

summary.conclusion: Recognizable priest portraits and attractive compositions, but these native outputs are more rendered/airbrushed than the Juggernaut6 reference. No quality or diversity reason in this half to prefer this configuration as the post-training base. No production approval.
